exercises.title: Raga Yaman - Aaroh, Avroh, Pakad
exercises.description: Repeat after the teacher: Yaman scale movement, pakad, and short chalan phrases.

raga.name: Yaman
raga.notes: Uses tivra Ma. Keep the movement phrase-led rather than plain scale-only.

exercises.title: Raga Bhoop - Full Lesson
exercises.description: Complete Raga Bhoop (Bhupali) lesson sourced from study material: Aaroh/Avroh, Pakad, Aalap, Swara Geet, Lakshana Geet, Chota Khayal (Teentaal), and Ardha Avarthi Taans.

raga.name: Bhoop (Bhupali)
raga.notes: Ma and Ni are varjit. Pakad: Ga Re Pa Ga Dha Pa Ga Re Sa Re Dha. Sa.

exercises.title: Raga Durga - Full Lesson
exercises.description: Complete Raga Durga lesson sourced from study material: Aaroh/Avroh, Pakad, Aalap, Swara Geet, Lakshana Geet, Chota Khayal (Teentaal), Taans, and Madhyalaya (Jhaptaal).

raga.name: Durga
raga.notes: Ga and Ni are varjit. Pakad: Dha Ma Re Pa — Ma Re Sa Re Dha. Sa. Dha is vadi; Re is samvadi.

exercises.title: Raga Kafi - Aaroh, Avroh, Pakad
exercises.description: Repeat after the teacher: Kafi with komal Ga and komal Ni in gentle phrase motion.

raga.name: Kafi
raga.notes: Uses komal Ga and komal Ni. Keep the descent relaxed and song-like.

exercises.title: Raga Khamaj - Aaroh, Avroh, Pakad
exercises.description: Repeat after the teacher: Khamaj with shuddha Ni in ascent and komal Ni in descent.

raga.name: Khamaj
raga.notes: Shuddha Ni appears in ascent; komal Ni is characteristic in descent.
